project.name: Primitive
release_notes: TimeMatch one-shot visitor confirmation: a visitor grant may request the minimal event-write scope online-only (Google calendar.events.owned with access_type=online; Microsoft Calendars.ReadWrite without offline_access), never a refresh token, so a customer can add the confirmed appointment and then be disconnected.

Connection.Close destroys borrowed credentials; a token Google issued but TimeMatch refuses (missing scope, missing or unexpected refresh) is revoked at Google instead of left live. Microsoft and Apple still report no programmatic revocation.
